name: nor12-fgac-authorization-flows
purpose: Normative compatibility assertions for documented Neo4j Enterprise FGAC authorization flows on synthetic data. This fixture contains no exploit, bypass, escalation or vulnerability-reproduction probe.

graph: CREATE (a:FGACDoc {id: 'doc-a', title: 'Alpha', published: true}), (b:FGACDoc {id: 'doc-b', title: 'Beta', published: false}), (c:FGACOther {id: 'other-a', title: 'Other'})
administration: CREATE USER fgac_linked SET AUTH 'oidc-comparison' { SET ID 'fgac-profile' }
CREATE ROLE fgac_reader IF NOT EXISTS
CREATE ROLE fgac_denier IF NOT EXISTS
CREATE ROLE fgac_access IF NOT EXISTS
CREATE ROLE fgac_noaccess IF NOT EXISTS
CREATE ROLE fgac_writer IF NOT EXISTS
CREATE USER fgac_access IF NOT EXISTS SET PASSWORD '${password}' CHANGE NOT REQUIRED
CREATE USER fgac_denied IF NOT EXISTS SET PASSWORD '${password}' CHANGE NOT REQUIRED
CREATE USER fgac_noaccess IF NOT EXISTS SET PASSWORD '${password}' CHANGE NOT REQUIRED
CREATE USER fgac_reader IF NOT EXISTS SET PASSWORD '${password}' CHANGE NOT REQUIRED
CREATE USER fgac_writer IF NOT EXISTS SET PASSWORD '${password}' CHANGE NOT REQUIRED
GRANT ROLE fgac_access TO fgac_access
GRANT ROLE fgac_reader TO fgac_reader
GRANT ROLE fgac_reader TO fgac_denied
GRANT ROLE fgac_denier TO fgac_denied
GRANT ROLE fgac_noaccess TO fgac_noaccess
GRANT ROLE fgac_writer TO fgac_writer
GRANT ACCESS ON DATABASE ${database} TO fgac_reader
GRANT TRAVERSE ON GRAPH ${database} NODES FGACDoc TO fgac_reader
GRANT READ { id, title } ON GRAPH ${database} NODES FGACDoc TO fgac_reader
GRANT ACCESS ON DATABASE ${database} TO fgac_access
DENY ACCESS ON DATABASE ${database} TO fgac_noaccess
DENY MATCH { * } ON GRAPH ${database} NODES FGACDoc TO fgac_denier
GRANT ACCESS ON DATABASE ${database} TO fgac_writer
GRANT CREATE ON GRAPH ${database} NODES FGACDoc TO fgac_writer
GRANT SET PROPERTY { * } ON GRAPH ${database} NODES FGACDoc TO fgac_writer
CREATE ROLE fgac_policy IF NOT EXISTS
CREATE USER fgac_policy IF NOT EXISTS SET PASSWORD '${password}' CHANGE NOT REQUIRED
GRANT ROLE fgac_policy TO fgac_policy
GRANT ACCESS ON DATABASE ${database} TO fgac_policy
GRANT MATCH {id} ON GRAPH ${database} FOR (d:FGACDoc) WHERE d.published = true TO fgac_policy

graph: MATCH (n) WHERE n:FGACDoc OR n:FGACOther DETACH DELETE n
administration: DROP USER fgac_linked IF EXISTS
DROP USER fgac_access IF EXISTS
DROP USER fgac_denied IF EXISTS
DROP USER fgac_noaccess IF EXISTS
DROP USER fgac_reader IF EXISTS
DROP USER fgac_writer IF EXISTS
DROP ROLE fgac_access IF EXISTS
DROP ROLE fgac_denier IF EXISTS
DROP ROLE fgac_noaccess IF EXISTS
DROP ROLE fgac_reader IF EXISTS
DROP ROLE fgac_writer IF EXISTS
DROP USER fgac_policy IF EXISTS
DROP ROLE fgac_policy IF EXISTS

cases.description: GRANT ROLE assigns the native role to the synthetic principal.
statements: SHOW USERS YIELD user, roles WHERE user = 'fgac_reader' AND 'fgac_reader' IN roles RETURN user AS user

cases.description: A granted database ACCESS privilege permits a scalar calculation.
A DENIED database ACCESS privilege refuses work that otherwise needs no graph privilege.
TRAVERSE on the label plus READ on the projected properties returns the synthetic documents.
statements: MATCH (d:FGACDoc) RETURN d.id AS id, d.title AS title ORDER BY id

cases.description: A DENY held by one of the principal's roles takes precedence over another role's GRANT.
statements: MATCH (d:FGACDoc) RETURN d.id AS id, d.title AS title ORDER BY id

cases.description: SHOW ROLE ... PRIVILEGES reports the granted access, read and traverse actions for the reader role.
statements: SHOW ROLE fgac_reader PRIVILEGES YIELD access, action WHERE access = 'GRANTED' RETURN DISTINCT action AS action ORDER BY action

cases.description: A principal holding read privileges but no scoped write privilege is refused an ordinary CREATE.
The refused CREATE left no synthetic node behind, observed through a fresh session.
A permitted write followed by a scoped write denial fails the transaction and rolls back the permitted write.
Neither the permitted nor the denied transaction write is observable through a fresh session.
statements: MATCH (n) WHERE (n:FGACDoc OR n:FGACOther) AND n.id IN ['tx-partial', 'tx-denied'] RETURN count(n) AS c

cases.description: A row condition is evaluated on the stored property without granting read access to it.
statements: MATCH (d:FGACDoc) RETURN d.id AS id, d.published AS published

cases.description: A creator applies its property privilege to a node it bound in the same statement.
The approved value is observable through an independent read after commit.
A supported impersonated session reads the graph with the target account's property grants.
statements: MATCH (d:FGACDoc) WHERE d.id IN ['doc-a', 'doc-b'] RETURN d.id, d.published ORDER BY d.id

cases.description: An impersonated reader receives the ordinary read-only response to a write.
The provider listing reports the configured external ID for the linked account.
statements: SHOW USERS WITH AUTH YIELD user, provider, auth WHERE user = 'fgac_linked' RETURN user, provider, auth.id AS externalID

administration: CREATE ROLE fgac_rule_reader IF NOT EXISTS
CREATE USER fgac_ruled IF NOT EXISTS SET PASSWORD '${password}' CHANGE NOT REQUIRED
GRANT ACCESS ON DATABASE ${database} TO fgac_rule_reader
CYPHER 25 ALTER USER fgac_ruled SET TAGS 'fgac-reports'
CYPHER 25 CREATE AUTH RULE fgac_reports_rule SET CONDITION 'fgac-reports' IN abac.native.user_tags()
CYPHER 25 GRANT ROLE fgac_rule_reader TO AUTH RULE fgac_reports_rule
CYPHER 25 DROP AUTH RULE fgac_reports_rule IF EXISTS
DROP USER fgac_ruled IF EXISTS
DROP ROLE fgac_rule_reader IF EXISTS

cases.description: An enabled Cypher 25 rule grants database access to the tagged user.
The rule listing returns the rule name, state and assigned role.
statements: CYPHER 25 SHOW AUTH RULES YIELD name, enabled, roles WHERE name = 'fgac_reports_rule' RETURN name, enabled, roles
